It also produces and commercializes Molybdenum-100, Molybdenum-98, and Ytterbium-176 for the nuclear medical industry. In addition, the company develops Zinc-68, Nickel-64, and Xenon-129/136 for the nuclear medical industry; Lithium-7, Uranium-235, and Chlorine-37 for the energy industry; and Germanium-70/72/74 for semiconductor markets. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Dallas, Texas.
